title: Rethinking the 2020s (scenario sketch)

entries.label: Waves (wealth first)
entries.quote: In a world that prioritises economic strength, the economic recovery from the global pandemic is relatively fast as economies successfully learn to live with COVID-19.
entries.subject: post-pandemic recovery

entries.label: Islands (security first)
entries.quote: In a world that prioritises self-sufficiency, countries protect their own narrowly defined self-interests.
entries.subject: post-pandemic recovery

entries.label: Sky (health first)
entries.quote: In a world that prioritises public health and well-being, the need for caution prevails.
entries.subject: post-pandemic recovery
entries.note: Shell: "A decade that prioritises health first begins a pathway most like the Shell Sky scenario."
